associate_tag_note: Set 2026-11-17 from the owner-supplied tracking ID shopnow047c-20 (brief: "Selected Tracking ID: shopnow047c-20"). Amazon Program Policies §2(a) requires Special Links to use the assigned Associates ID and §2(b) requires the tag as a URL parameter on every link, so the build appends ?tag=<this> to every /dp/<ASIN> link and fails if any outbound product link lacks it. The tag format (xxxxx-20) is validated against the §2(b) pattern before any page is written. Recorded in data/intent-record.json as the site's own tag; it is NOT evidence that the five supplied link.amazon links carry it.
